name: International Business Digital Technology Limited
summary: International Business Digital Technology Limited, an investment holding company, provides Internet and Web application performance management (APM) products and services in the telecommunications industry in Mainland China and internationally. The company offers integrated APM system solutions, software development services, and maintenance and technical support services; embedded hardware and standard APM software; and CBDC solutions.
